crossRefs.note: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

translations.web: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
translations.bsb: “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
translations.kjv: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
translations.asv: I say unto thee, Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thy house.
